ANKIT OJHA AI Product Manager | Delivery Manager | Scrum Master

connect.ankitojha@gmail.com | +91-7985023920 | linkedin.com/in/connectankitojha | New Delhi, India

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Product Manager with ~9 years in product and delivery across Healthcare, MarTech/AdTech, AutoTech and Telecom, including ~3 years hands-on GenAI and Agentic AI product ownership. PMP®, SAFe® 6 Agilist, CSPO®, CSM®.

Shipped GenAI in production. Own a RAG-based Tier-1 customer care assistant handling ~40,000 support interactions per month for a global consumer healthcare (OTC) business — 91% agent adoption, 15.5% AHT reduction (8.4 to 7.1 min), hallucination rate held at 3% against a 5% release gate and 90% retrieval accuracy sustained in production.

Delivery track record: 25% sprint velocity gain, 15% project cost reduction through scope governance, and 30% reduction in post-release rework across enterprise SaaS programs.

SKILLS

Agentic AI / GenAI Product: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LLMOps, Prompt Engineering, Embeddings & Vector Databases, Chunking & Top-K Retrieval Tuning, Model Evaluation & Held-Out Test Sets, Groundedness & Hallucination Guardrails, Token & Inference Cost Management, Fine-Tuning, API Function Calling, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Architecture, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Responsible AI, Model Drift Monitoring.

Product Management: 0-to-1 Product Strategy, Product Roadmapping, OKRs & KPI Definition, Customer Discovery & Requirement Elicitation, MoSCoW Prioritization, PRD / BRD / FRD / NFR Authoring, Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy, Gap & SWOT Analysis, Product Analytics, A/B Testing & Experimentation, Stakeholder Management.

Agile Delivery & Governance: Product Ownership (Scrum / SAFe), Backlog Refinement, Program Increment (PI) Planning, Agile Release Train (ART), Sprint Planning / Review / Retrospective, Gherkin Acceptance Criteria, Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM), UAT Sign-Off, Risk & Scope Governance, RACI Matrix, Root Cause Analysis (Ishikawa).

Data & Analytics: SQL, Enterprise Data Dictionaries, Data Schema Mapping, KPI-to-Model Mapping, Power BI Dashboarding, Advanced Excel, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).

Platforms & Tools: Jira, Jira Automation, Confluence, Aha!, Azure DevOps (ADO), Azure Monitor, Miro, Mural, Figma, Balsamiq; Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4o, Google Gemini, LangChain, Hugging Face, n8n, Cursor IDE, GitHub Copilot, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Foundry.

Cloud & Infrastructure: Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Databricks, Microsoft SharePoint, GCP, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

WNS Global Services Pvt. Ltd. (Part of Capgemini) | Gurugram, India Assistant Manager — GenAI & Agentic AI (Healthcare) Flagship product: Tier-1 Customer Care Assistant (RAG) for a global consumer healthcare (OTC) client — ~40,000 support interactions/month

Feb 2025 – Present

Ran the full 6-phase CPMAI life cycle from business case to post-deployment monitoring with a cross-functional pod of 12 ML engineers, data scientists and developers across 5 geographies, delivering a $378K annualized run-rate benefit.

Architected the retrieval layer on Azure AI Search — vector retrieval with semantic reranking, plus metadata filters and scoring profiles that keep answers scoped to the right SKU and geography. Converted a stale, contradictory knowledge base (312-page product PDFs, FAQs, 90,000 historical tickets, ~16% stale) into ~1,200 governed embedded chunks, cutting token cost 35% at top-3 retrieval while defending baseline accuracy.

Designed the conversation and telemetry store on Azure Cosmos DB — session state, interaction transcripts, agent feedback and override events.

Stood up build, evaluation and deployment on Azure AI Foundry — model benchmarking and selection, prompt orchestration and versioning, content safety filters, and automated groundedness/relevance evaluations wired directly into the release gate, giving a repeatable path from prompt change to production.

Defined the evaluation strategy and release gate: held-out test sets and groundedness checks that shipped the agent at a 3% hallucination rate against a 5% executive gate.

Built healthcare-specific guardrails: authored and iterated system prompts in the Azure AI Foundry playground to restrict responses to MLR-approved product labeling — no dosing, diagnostic or off-label claims — layered content safety filters on top, and fine-tuned the model on curated healthcare support conversations to improve tone and domain accuracy.

Built the LLMOps monitoring layer — proxy drift signals (agent override rate, retrieval miss rate) surfaced on Azure dashboards, which detected and reversed a live production accuracy drop before it reached SLA breach.

Ran SAFe cadence for the product line: backlog refinement, PI Planning, and Agile Release Train syncs across distributed international teams.

AdGlobal360 India Pvt. Ltd. | Gurugram, India Analyst – Projects (Product & Delivery) — Automotive OEM SaaS Products: Honda & Suzuki SaaS suite — Lead Quality System (LQS), CMS, dealer web portals, dealership sales platform

Oct 2022 – Feb 2025

Defined MVP scope for automotive SaaS products using gap analysis, SWOT and MoSCoW prioritization, serving multiple dealerships across 4 markets.

Authored PRD, BRD, FRD and NFR documentation with interactive developer walkthroughs — reduced post-deployment rework by 30%.

Facilitated full Scrum cadence (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and rigorous backlog refinement — lifted team sprint velocity 25%.

Delivered 15% project cost reduction through proactive risk mitigation, scope-creep control and structured change governance.

Engineered enterprise data dictionaries and schema mapping to translate business operations into database migration scripts during enterprise CRM overhauls.

Owned Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTM) and UAT sign-off; drove releases from discovery through GTM rollout across full SDLC.

Earlier Experience — AdTech, MarTech & Programmatic Platforms

Publicis Global Delivery | Gurugram, India Associate Manager — AdTech (DSP, SSP & Programmatic Platforms)

Nov 2021 – Oct 2022

Partnered with QA engineering on scenario-based requirement walkthroughs to maximize automated test coverage and eliminate defects pre-production.

Executed Root Cause Analysis using Ishikawa (Fishbone) diagrams and RACI mapping; reported delivery status to executives via sprint demos, roadmap reviews and Jira/Confluence dashboards.

Omnicom Media Group India Pvt. Ltd. | Gurugram, India Senior Associate — Agile Delivery

Apr 2021 – Nov 2021

Tracked sprint trajectory via Jira burndown charts and velocity metrics; accelerated feature deployment by refining user stories and enforcing Definition of Ready (DoR) standards.

Cognizant Technology Solutions India Pvt. Ltd. | Gurugram, India Process Executive — Marcel Cloud SaaS Platform

Jul 2019 – Mar 2021

Supported real-time bidding (RTB) engine infrastructure and ad auction workflows on a global programmatic platform built for microsecond scalability; administered change requests and hotfix deployments across Dev, Staging, UAT and Production.

Smart Software Services (I) Pvt. Ltd. | Pune, India Research Analyst

Jan 2018 – Jun 2019

Managed project charters, stakeholder communications and schedule tracking against client milestones; ran market research and competitor benchmarking to inform feature backlog prioritization.

CERTIFICATIONS

Project Management Professional (PMP®) – Project Management Institute (2025) · SAFe® 6 Agilist – Scaled Agile (2024) · Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO®) – Scrum Alliance (2024) · Certified ScrumMaster (CSM®) – Scrum Alliance (2024)

Additional: Generative AI & Prompt Engineering – PMI (2025); Registered Product Owner™ & Registered Scrum Master™ – Scrum Inc. (2025); Generative AI Fundamentals – Databricks (2025); Modern AI Fundamentals – Cisco (2025).

Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech), Electrical & Electronics Engineering – ABES Engineering College, AKTU (2018)
